title: AI 问询首页 T3：首页列出本应用的最近对话
body:

Filing gate: ① maintainer-asked. Jack in the seat thread, 2026-11-27: 「立卡派发」 (02:37Z); route ruling 「先内置页面，再做页面积木」 (02:41Z card); 「我们是一个开发平台，你搭的入口页面必须是通用的」 (02:51Z); 「用fable评审一下完整的首页方案，我现在只要考虑这一个页面」 (03:07Z); ADR-0057 conflict ruling 「做首页，本页隐藏机器人」 (03:16Z card).
Plan: `/mnt/project-files/ai-home/plan-v1.md`, Fable review with file:line evidence `/mnt/project-files/ai-home/fable-review-v1.md` (objectstack `da31daff`, cloud `917f57c`). Mockup: https://claude.ai/artifact/SS7UdUYXethLuvV8f5D7JY.

Dedupe: searched `recent conversations activePackageId`: none.

## 维护者速读
- 是什么：AI 问询页首页态下方列"最近的对话"，只列本应用、从这一页发起的对话（最多 5 条），另有"全部对话"打开右侧抽屉的历史。
- 已定：只算本页发起的，抽屉里的不算（Jack 未反对的默认，03:14Z）。
- 要你做什么：无。

## Background
- The conversation list filters only by `userId` / `agentId`; `metadata` is a JSON string column (cloud `packages/service-ai/src/conversation/objectql-conversation-service.ts:296,356-364`); list rows carry `metadata` (`:767`). #37788 makes this page write `metadata.activePackageId`.

## What to do
1. On the home state, fetch the caller's latest 50 conversations (existing list call), keep those whose `metadata.activePackageId` is this app's package, show the newest 5 (title + relative time); click opens it in the page (`?c=`).
2. "全部对话" opens the drawer's history (`useOpenAssistant` or the existing opener), not a full page.
3. Extend the client conversation type to carry `metadata`. No server change in this card (a server-side package filter is a later card if 50 proves too few).

## Acceptance
- A conversation of another app, or one started in the drawer, does not appear; empty state when none.
- Tests for the filter and the empty state.
